hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the track out is south

spots.line: A pool of clear water, fed from somewhere deep under the limestone.
Tracks of four different things that came to drink in the night.
Date stones scattered under the shade, clean and dry.
The heat rises off the sand in waves the moment you step out of the shade.

chests.line: A brass jar buried to its neck in the drift, stoppered with wax.

people.name: Sabir the Water-Watcher
chatter: Take what you need for the skins. Do not foul the source.
Three days south before you find another drop. Mind your compass.
The sand moves every night. The water stays where it is.

people.name: a sun lizard on the stone
chatter: It sits motionless on the warm slab, soaking the noon heat.
